panels.headline: Multimodal agentic systems tackle real-world challenges, but current evaluation methods are inadequate.
content: Multimodal agentic systems have evolved to solve real-world problems.
Current evaluation methods focus only on final outcomes or require extensive manual labor.
Code generation benchmarks do not reflect practical challenges faced by developers.

panels.headline: Lack of intermediate feedback and high cost of human evaluation.
content: Current methods lack feedback during intermediate task-solving stages.
Existing benchmarks do not accurately represent real-world AI development tasks.
Human evaluation is expensive and time-consuming.

panels.headline: Agent-as-a-Judge framework evaluates agentic systems with rich intermediate feedback.
content: Introduce the Agent-as-a-Judge framework for evaluating agentic systems.
Extend the LLM-as-a-Judge framework to incorporate agentic features.
panels.figure_caption: Comparison of Agent-as-a-Judge, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Human-as-a-Judge frameworks.

panels.headline: Evaluate three leading open-source code-generating agentic frameworks on DevAI tasks.
content: Apply MetaGPT, GPT-Pilot, and OpenHands to the DevAI tasks.
Compare their performance using human judges, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Agent-as-a-Judge frameworks.

panels.headline: Agent-as-a-Judge aligns 90% with human judges, saving 97.72% time and 97.64% cost.
content: Agent-as-a-Judge aligns more closely with human judges (90%) compared to LLM-as-a-Judge (70%).
Agent-as-a-Judge saves 97.72% of the time and 97.64% of the cost compared to involving three human experts.
panels.figure_caption: Distribution of DevAI tasks and common terms in queries.

panels.headline: Agent-as-a-Judge provides rich and reliable reward signals, making it a cost-effective and efficient evaluation method.
content: Agent-as-a-Judge marks a significant step forward in evaluating agentic systems.
It provides rich and reliable reward signals, making it a viable replacement for human evaluators in many scenarios.
The framework is cost-effective and efficient.
Further refinement may be needed for broader applications.
The DevAI dataset is a valuable resource for AI development tasks.
The study provides a comprehensive analysis of top open-source code generation agentic frameworks.
